registry.name: Policy agent
registry.technique: Deterministic rule checks; evidence retrieved once at start-up (BM25, verbatim quotes)
outputs: verdicts with evidence status and citations

registry.name: Safety agent
registry.technique: Deterministic checks on emergency service, power concentration and starvation

registry.name: Supervisor (coordinator / mediator)
registry.technique: Fixed precedence - hard limits > operating constraints > safety > optimisation; conflict log; escalation
allowed_actions: apply exemptions defined by the profile
prohibited_actions: invent an exemption the profile does not grant
failure_modes: none handled - a Supervisor exception stops the run

registry.name: Traffic forecaster
registry.technique: Residual GRU over persistence, 3-slot horizon, causal uncertainty gate
failure_modes: high recent error -> gate falls back to persistence

registry.name: Telemetry validator
registry.technique: Finite/non-negative/stale checks, last-good imputation, conservative mode

registry.name: BAM guard
registry.technique: Deterministic validation and repair of beam count, power budget, floors, signalling deadlines, caps

registry.name: Decision explainer
registry.technique: Deterministic localised templates over measured results (en, ar, hi, ta)
prohibited_actions: state numbers not present in the result

entries.title: Architectural framework for machine learning in future networks including IMT-2020
entries.scope: ML pipeline (source, collector, preprocessor, model, policy, distributor, sink), ML sandbox, MLFO
entries.requirement: Model output passes a policy function before it reaches the network; models are trained and validated in a sandbox
entries.not_implemented: No ML Function Orchestrator (MLFO), no ML intent, no standard interfaces between pipeline nodes; mapping is by design, not tested conformance.
entries.next_step: Express the profile + scenario as a Y.3172-style ML intent and map pipeline nodes to named interfaces.

entries.title: Framework for evaluating intelligence levels of future networks including IMT-2020
entries.scope: Levels of network intelligence across action implementation, data collection, analysis, decision
entries.requirement: Assess the intelligence level of each network operation dimension
entries.not_implemented: No intelligence-level assessment has been made; the document is not in the knowledge base.
entries.next_step: Add the document to the corpus and score each pipeline stage against its levels.

entries.title: Framework for data handling to enable machine learning in future networks including IMT-2020
entries.scope: Data collection, processing and provenance for ML in networks
entries.requirement: Documented data sources, handling and quality for ML
entries.not_implemented: Data handling is documented and tested for leakage and corruption, but not structured per Y.3174; document not in the corpus.
entries.next_step: Map dataset, split and validator metadata to the Y.3174 data-handling functions.

entries.title: Maximum permissible values of power flux-density at the surface of the Earth produced by satellites in the fixed-satellite service using the same frequency bands above 1 GHz as line-of-sight radio-relay systems
entries.scope: Surface power flux-density limits by angle of arrival
entries.requirement: PFD at the Earth's surface stays below the angle-dependent mask
entries.not_implemented: Indicative only - 20 GHz lies outside the listed bands and Tx gain is assumed; not part of the default flood scenario.
entries.next_step: Apply the mask that actually governs the simulated band, with a reviewed antenna pattern.

entries.title: Functional description for software to determine conformance of NGSO FSS systems with EPFD limits
entries.scope: Equivalent power flux-density (EPFD) evaluation for NGSO systems
entries.requirement: EPFD statistics computed per the functional description
entries.not_implemented: No EPFD computation; one satellite and one pass only.
entries.next_step: Multi-satellite constellation geometry before any EPFD estimate is meaningful.

entries.title: Maximum permissible levels of off-axis e.i.r.p. density from earth stations in GSO networks
entries.scope: Earth-station uplink emissions in GSO networks
entries.requirement: Off-axis e.i.r.p. density limits for earth stations
entries.not_implemented: OrbitFlow schedules LEO downlink beams only; no earth-station uplink is modelled.
entries.next_step: None unless uplink scheduling is added.

entries.title: Study on New Radio (NR) to support non-terrestrial networks
entries.scope: NTN deployment scenarios and channel models
entries.requirement: NTN channel characteristics (path loss, shadowing, elevation dependence)
entries.not_implemented: Channel models are not run live; the second test trace is an offline OpenNTN/Sionna output. 3GPP documents are not in the corpus.
entries.next_step: Generate traces from the TR 38.811 models directly for several elevations and orbits.

entries.title: Solutions for NR to support non-terrestrial networks (NTN)
entries.scope: NTN timing, feeder links, beam/cell relations, mobility
entries.requirement: Account for large and varying propagation delay in control loops
entries.not_implemented: Delay is a fixed one-slot telemetry lag; no timing advance, feeder link or handover.
entries.next_step: Model elevation-dependent delay and inter-satellite handover.

entries.title: NR overall description; physical layer procedures for control (SSB)
entries.scope: Initial access signalling (SSB, SIB) and NTN support in NR
entries.requirement: Every cell receives synchronisation and system information often enough for initial access
entries.not_implemented: The 40/80-slot deadlines are configuration assumptions, not derived from the specification (GAP-02).
entries.next_step: Derive the deadlines from the SSB periodicity and SIB scheduling of the target configuration.

entries.title: DVB-S2X superframe formats, including beam-hopping support
entries.scope: Physical-layer framing that carries beam-hopping illumination
entries.requirement: Beam switching aligned to superframe boundaries with defined switching overhead
entries.not_implemented: Capacity is Shannon-based; no MODCOD table, no superframe, and beam switching has no cost in the simulator.
entries.next_step: Add a MODCOD table and a switching penalty, then re-evaluate BRIDGE's higher switch rate.

entries.title: O-RAN Alliance E2 and near-real-time RIC specifications
entries.organization: O-RAN Alliance (industry specification body, not an SDO)
entries.scope: Telemetry reporting and control from a near-real-time controller
entries.requirement: Controller acts on periodic, delayed reports through a standard interface
entries.not_implemented: No E2 interface or xApp packaging; telemetry delay is modelled only.
entries.next_step: Wrap the decision loop as an xApp against an E2 simulator.

entries.title: Artificial intelligence - Management system
entries.requirement: Defined roles, risk treatment, monitoring and records for AI systems
entries.not_implemented: No management system exists; OrbitFlow only produces artefacts (registry, audit trail, profiles) an AIMS could use.
entries.next_step: None at prototype stage; relevant once an operator adopts the system.

entries.title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework
entries.scope: Govern, Map, Measure, Manage functions for AI risk
entries.requirement: Measure and manage AI failure modes with documented fallbacks
entries.not_implemented: No formal RMF profile; the mapping is informal.
entries.next_step: Write a RMF profile listing each registry failure mode as a measured risk.

entries.title: FCC document on NGSO FSS EPFD limits (United States)
entries.scope: US position on NGSO downlink limits in 19.7-20.2 GHz
entries.requirement: NGSO downlink limits apply in the 19.7-20.2 GHz band
entries.not_implemented: Evidence is retrieved and quoted only; the rule status of this document should be checked and it applies to the US only.
entries.next_step: Legal review before it informs any profile.

framework.title: ITU AI Ready - Analysis Towards a Standardized Readiness Framework, Report 2.0

maturity_scale.2: Implemented in simulation - code exists and runs end-to-end
maturity_scale.3: Tested in simulation - covered by automated tests or seeded, repeatable studies
maturity_scale.4: Externally validated - independent data, review or partner trial
maturity_scale.5: Operational - running in a live network

factors.justification: Three offline datasets are documented and used; splits are leak-tested. Data quality is not independently assessed and OrbitFlow publishes no new dataset.
factors.gap: No real operator traffic; demand in training and scenarios is synthetic.

tests.about: The claims the demo makes about the agent layer, checked on a full flood-relief run.
Operations API: scenarios, policy profiles, multilingual requests, registry and governance.
The sampler and its log-probability must agree, or the policy gradient is wrong.
Test event engine with information asymmetry enforcement.
The forecast at slot t must not depend on demand the controller has not seen.
The game's JavaScript twin must reproduce recorded Python runs, or the score would be unfair.
Test BAM guardrail constraint satisfaction and repair logic.
Multilingual input and output: locale completeness, language detection, digit handling, explanations.
Link-budget equations checked against hand-calculable references, the dataset, and the twin.
Standards, readiness and knowledge-catalogue files: valid statuses, real evidence paths, real documents.
Test data leakage prevention in train/val/test splits.
Policy profiles: validation, conflict detection, and 'same traffic + same model + different profile -> different permitted action'.
Knowledge base: real-corpus provenance plus toy-fixture behaviour. Fixtures are labelled synthetic and only used here.
Agent registry: contracts are complete, required parts cannot be disabled, implementations are replaceable.
Coordinator behaviour under agent failure, malformed output, timeouts and corrupted telemetry.
Scenario suite: definitions are complete, scenarios run through the pipeline, results are reproducible.
Forecasting, BRIDGE, simulation, agent and API behaviour.
Test digital twin correctness: queue conservation, capacity, energy, etc.
